title: Bowtie's Bundles
description: A Retexture of every bundle, just for funsies!
body:
This pack features a retexture of each bundle option! Having been practicing my pixel art more, I wanted to share my work.

![Wall of dyed bundles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2933b625207123ab0f88327e67adfac8f5d5cb48.png)

I hope you enjoy!
